title: SupremeAI 5-Section Deterministic Instruction Envelope
description: Canonical instruction envelope handed to an AI coding agent for a single task. Deterministic: two renders of the same task must produce byte-identical envelopes. The five sections map 1:1 onto the task-delivery pipeline: (1) role contract and operating constraints, (2) task objective and scope boundary, (3) governing rules and policies, (4) the 3-tier verification contract (reflection check, boot smoke test, test suite; evidence tiers SSOT'd in docs/AGENT_LOOP_SPEC.md section 4), and (5) the universal PR submission template. Closed vocabularies (roles, task types, groups, priorities) mirror scripts/agents/continuous_agent_loop.py and docs/AGENT_LOOP_SPEC.md sections 2-3 so an envelope can never drift from the dispatch registry. See issue #30.

schema_version.description: Semantic version of this envelope document itself (e.g. "1.0"). Bump when the envelope shape changes.

envelope_format.description: Format discriminator. A renderer emitting a different major layout MUST change this tag.

target.description: Coordinates of the task this envelope instructs the agent to execute.

issue.description: Tracking issue number in the target repository, as a string (mirrors task-envelope-v1).

repository.description: Full name of the target repository (owner/repo).

task_type.description: VALID_TASK_TYPES from scripts/agents/continuous_agent_loop.py — agents cannot invent task types.

priority.description: Priority tier, matching the issue label taxonomy (P0-critical..P3-low).

roleContract.description: Section 1 — who the agent is for this task and the constraints it operates under.

role.description: One of the 7 specialist roles from the dispatch registry.

role_description.description: Human-readable mandate of the assigned role (verbatim from the registry where applicable).

operating_constraints.description: Hard behavioral constraints: continuous-loop authorization, confirmation policy, reporting language, escalation rules.

stop_conditions.description: Enumerated conditions under which the agent must abort the task instead of improvising (hard blockers only).

taskScope.description: Section 2 — what to build and the exact boundary the work must stay inside.

objective.description: Single-sentence mission statement; must be specific enough that two agents would produce equivalent scopes.

problem_statement.description: Optional verbatim problem context from the source issue.

touching_files.description: Scope Gate boundary: repository paths the change may touch. Enforced by the pipeline boundary guard; any out-of-bound edit fails CI.

forbidden_paths.description: Paths never touchable by contributors (constitutional defaults: .env*, secrets/**, credentials/**, vault/**).

acceptance_criteria.description: Checklist the final state must satisfy, verbatim from the issue where applicable.

governingRules.description: Section 3 — the policies this task is governed by and whether an admin gate applies.

policies.description: Citable policy bindings; every constraint in section 1 should trace to at least one policy here.

admin_gate.description: Whether an ADMIN_DECISION must precede or approve this task (mirrors task-envelope-v1 admin_gate).

required.description: True only for constitution-changing or taxonomy-changing work.

status.description: Gate lifecycle status as seen by the dispatching system.

verificationContract.description: Section 4 — the 3-tier verification contract every task must satisfy before submission.

contract_version.description: CONTRACT_VERSION parity tag shared with scripts/agents/continuous_agent_loop.py (docs/AGENT_LOOP_SPEC.md section 4b).

tiers.description: Exactly the 3 tiers, each present exactly once: contains-clauses below pin tiers 1, 2 and 3.

required_evidence.description: Artifacts that must be pasted into the PR description as completion proof.

submissionTemplate.description: Section 5 — the universal PR submission template; encoded so the pipeline's issue-reference and branch-naming guards can never be failed by a compliant envelope.

pathway.description: Pathway 1 (pull_request) or Pathway 2 (bridge_submit_patch) per AGENTS.md section 2.1 and section 8.

base_branch.description: Branch the change must land on; 'main' for the public repository.

branch_convention.description: Branch-naming regex enforced by .github/workflows/pipeline.yml (Branch-Naming Guard); quoted verbatim so the envelope is self-contained.

pr_title_prefix.description: Conventional-commit prefix to open the PR title (e.g. "feat(schemas):").

issue_reference_required.description: Immutable: the pipeline issue-reference guard rejects any PR whose title/body lacks an issue reference.

closes_reference.description: Exact close-keyword line that must appear in the PR body so the merge gate auto-closes the task issue.

pr_body_template.description: Markdown skeleton of the PR body; MUST embed the same Closes #N line as closes_reference.

policyItem.description: One citable policy: stable id, enforceable statement, and where it is written down.

statement.description: Enforceable one-sentence statement of the policy.

source.description: Canonical location (file/section) the policy is written down at.

verificationTier.description: One tier of the 3-tier verification contract.

tier.description: Tier ordinal: 1 = reflection check, 2 = boot smoke test, 3 = test suite.

name.description: Canonical tier name; name and ordinal are pinned together by the envelope renderer.

command.description: Offline-safe shell command that executes the tier check from the repository root.

expectation.description: Pass criterion of the command, in one sentence.
